zh: 已载入到"我的策略"：§0§。别人写的代码在隔离环境里运行。
en: Loaded into "My strategies": §0§. Code written by other people runs in an isolated environment.

zh: 内容比较长，放不进地址里，所以分两步：先点"复制内容"，再点"去 GitHub 提交"；在打开的页面里把正文整段换成刚复制的内容，然后点 Submit new issue。
en: The content is too long to fit in the address, so there are two steps: first click "Copy content", then click "Submit on GitHub"; on the page that opens, replace the whole body with what you just copied, then click Submit new issue.

zh: 点"去 GitHub 提交"会打开 GitHub 的新建 Issue 页面，内容已经填好；在那里点 Submit new issue 就交上去了。
en: Clicking "Submit on GitHub" opens GitHub's new-issue page with the content already filled in; click Submit new issue there and it is posted.

zh: 需要一个 GitHub 账号。交上去的东西是公开的，署的是你的 GitHub 用户名；别人可以载入、运行和修改它。想撤下来，把那条 Issue 关掉就行。
en: You need a GitHub account. What you post is public and carries your GitHub username; others can load, run and modify it. To take it down, just close that issue.
